expectations.text: Identifies that PlaceBidCommand handler doesn't verify caller identity against BidderId
expectations.evidence: FINDING-1: 'BidderId is a caller-supplied parameter... The handler passes this directly to the domain: auction.PlaceBid(request.BidderId, ...). There is no code anywhere in PlaceBidCommandHandler... that checks request.BidderId == currentUserId.'

expectations.text: Notes the seller-cannot-bid-on-own-auction protection in the Auction aggregate
expectations.evidence: 'What the Domain Gets Right' section: 'Seller self-bid prevention: Auction.cs line 92 — if (bidderId == SellerId) returns DomainErrors.Auction.CannotBidOnOwnAuction. Enforced in the aggregate, not just the API layer.'

expectations.text: Mentions optimistic concurrency / version/xmin token in the context of race conditions
expectations.evidence: 'Optimistic concurrency: The Version field on Auction.cs is incremented on every mutating operation... Infrastructure layer uses xmin-based concurrency tokens. PlaceBidCommandHandler retries up to 3 times on ConcurrencyException'

expectations.text: References the Auction.cs aggregate source file
expectations.evidence: Multiple explicit references: 'src/services/AuctionKings.Domain/Aggregates/Auction.cs', 'Auction.cs line 92', listed in 'Files Reviewed' section
